What is CertSolitaire?

CertSolitaire is a free Android study app that turns CompTIA exam topics into an active-recall sorting game. It covers A+, Network+ N10-009, and Security+ SY0-701, works offline, and requires no account.

A study loop built around retrieval

Each round asks you to produce an answer instead of recognizing one on a page. The feedback stays tied to the concept you just practiced.

Read the card

A port, protocol, attack, control, command, device, or troubleshooting step appears as the prompt.

Sort it into the right bin

Match the card to its conceptual category. Every placement becomes a focused retrieval rep.

Use the miss

If you place a card incorrectly, CertSolitaire unlocks a targeted mnemonic to help the concept stick.

Three current CompTIA tracks

Choose one exam path or mix all three in CompTIA Triad mode.

S+

Security+ (SY0-701)

Threats, the CIA triad, architecture, security operations, and compliance.

N+

Network+ (N10-009)

OSI layers, routing, Wi-Fi, protocols, ports, and troubleshooting.

A+

A+ (Core 1 & 2)

Hardware, mobile devices, Windows and Linux, virtualization, and troubleshooting methodology.

Questions, answered directly

What is CertSolitaire?

CertSolitaire is an Android study game that turns CompTIA exam topics into active-recall card sorting. You match technical concepts to the correct categories and get immediate feedback.

Which CompTIA exams does it cover?

It includes CompTIA Security+ SY0-701, Network+ N10-009, A+ Core 1 and Core 2, and a mixed CompTIA Triad mode.

Is the app free?

Yes. The core app and exam tracks are free and ad-free. Three specialized expansion decks are optional in-app purchases.

Does it work offline?

Yes. CertSolitaire works fully offline and requires no account. The app states that it collects no personal data and shares nothing with third parties.

What happens when I miss a card?

A missed card unlocks a targeted mnemonic tied to that concept, so the mistake becomes a focused review prompt.

Is CertSolitaire affiliated with CompTIA?

No. CertSolitaire is an independent study tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by CompTIA, Inc. Its practice content is original and does not reproduce live exam questions.
